donor.runs:
; Layer C: multi-page runs. Level 0 holds the entries; each sealed page's
; first key and parent-held reference become one entry of the level above.
; A build owns one writer row per level; its caller supplies pages and
; records each sealed page. Every call is bounded; :more resumes.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-geometry")
(include-book "runs-schema")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

; A format parameter, not a ceiling on stored entries: with 64 KiB pages and
; index entries of at most 350 bytes, six levels address over 10^13 pages.

; Field rows a build owns: one writer range per level, then one index-entry
; region where a sealed page's first key and reference are assembled.
(defconst *fn2-run-build-index* (* *fn2-run-max-levels* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-run-build-fields* (+ *fn2-run-build-index* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))

(defcolumns fn2-run-builds
 ((phase (:enum fn2-run-build-phase (:idle :adding :finishing :done :failed)))
  (schema :u60) (run :u60) (height :u8) (wbase :u32) (entries :u60) (pages :u60)
  (crow :u32) (hbase :u32) (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (fields :u32) (limit :u32)
  (history :u60) (incarnation :u60) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))

(defcolumns-predicate fn2-run-buildp (b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 :shape ((fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers))
 :tests ((natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
      (<= (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-max-levels*)
          (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-writer (b level)
 `(+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase ,b fn2-run-builds) ,level))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-phase (b level)
 `(fn2-run-writers-phase (fn2-run-level-writer ,b ,level) fn2-run-writers))

; Idle every level writer of a build, ordinal zero.
(defun fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix n)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp n) (natp w))))
 (cond ((zp n) (mv :ok fn2-run-writers))
       ((not (and (natp w) (< (+ w (- n 1)) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-writers))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-put (+ w (- n 1)) (phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*) (ordinal 0))))
           (fn2-run-reset-writers (- n 1) w fn2-run-writers)))))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers) :position 1 :raw-rows t)

; Start a build. The hash slot is a C-owned workspace whose first
; 32 * levels bytes are zeroed here; level L's sealed hash is copied to
; offset 32 L for its parent entry.
(defun fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation
                             okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 schema) (unsigned-byte-p 60 run) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fields) (unsigned-byte-p 32 limit)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 history) (unsigned-byte-p 60 incarnation)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((unless (member (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds)
                       (list *fn2-run-build-phase-idle* *fn2-run-build-phase-done*)))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reset hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-run-zero (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*) hslot hgen 0 okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-reset-writers *fn2-run-max-levels* wbase fn2-run-writers))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-put b (phase *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*) (schema schema) (run run)
                        (height 0) (wbase wbase) (entries 0) (pages 0) (crow crow) (hbase hbase)
                        (hslot hslot) (hgen hgen) (fields fields) (limit limit)
                        (history history) (incarnation incarnation) (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil
 :hyps ((fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil)
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; Give level LEVEL a fresh page: a C-owned 64 KiB workspace and its physical
; identity, from the caller's allocator reservation. The page's ordinal is
; the build's page count at that level, kept in the writer row across pages.
(defun fn2-run-build-page-kind (b level slot gen unit epoch counter page-kind fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 8 page-kind) (natp level) (< level *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< level (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (w (fn2-run-level-writer b level))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (ordinal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
       (fn2-run-open w slot gen (fn2-run-builds-schema b fn2-run-builds) 1 level
                     (fn2-run-builds-run b fn2-run-builds) ordinal
                     page-kind
                     unit epoch counter (fn2-run-builds-history b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-incarnation b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-okind b fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-oslot b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-ogen b fn2-run-builds)
                     (+ (fn2-run-builds-fields b fn2-run-builds) (* level *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
                     (fn2-run-builds-limit b fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
; Default callers retain the ordinary run page kinds. A directory producer
; uses the same implementation with its declared :manifest page kind.
(defun fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (fn2-run-build-page-kind b level slot gen unit epoch counter
  (if (zp level) *page-kind-run-data* *page-kind-run-index*) fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil)
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; All levels below L idle.
(defun fn2-run-below-idle (l wbase fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix l)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp l) (natp wbase)
              (<= (+ wbase l) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))))
 (or (zp l)
     (and (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (fn2-run-below-idle (- l 1) wbase fn2-run-writers))))
; The highest level that needs action, top down: (mv action level).
(defun fn2-run-scan (l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) :measure (nfix (+ 1 l))
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (integerp l) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*))))
 (if (or (not (integerp l)) (< l 0)) (mv :idle 0)
  (let* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds)) (w (+ wbase l))
         (phase (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers)))
   (cond ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-closing*) (mv :close-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-heading*) (mv :head l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealing*) (mv :seal-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-failed*) (mv :failed l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*)
          (if (and finishing (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
                   (equal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers) 0)
                   (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers))
              (mv :root l) (mv :promote l)))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (if (and (< 0 l) (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
              (mv :need-page l)
            (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
         ((and finishing (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers)) (mv :finish-close l))
         (t (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))))))

(defthm fn2-run-scan-level-natp
 (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :typed-term (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))))

; One bounded unit of pending page work. Returns (mv code level ...): :more
; after work, (:sealed L) once when a page has sealed (its writer row then
; names the page; the caller records it), and without work (:promote L),
; (:need-page L), (:root L) or :idle for the caller to act on.
(defun fn2-run-build-work (b budget fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool
                             fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-restarts-wfp fn2-run-restarts)
              (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc)
              (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests) (natp budget))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-scan fn2-run-close-step fn2-run-head fn2-run-seal-step fn2-run-seal-context fn2-run-close
                                            fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows)))))
 (b* ((finishing (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing*))
      (height (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (<= height *fn2-run-max-levels*))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
      ((mv action l) (fn2-run-scan (- height 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
      (w (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      (crow (fn2-run-builds-crow b fn2-run-builds))
      (hrow (+ (fn2-run-builds-hbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (fn2-run-writerp w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields)
                    (< crow (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (< crow (fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-fc-context))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hrow)))
       (mv :bounds l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
  (case action
   (:close-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool)
          (fn2-run-close-step w budget fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
     (mv (if (member-eq code '(:ok :more)) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:head
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-head w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (< (fn2-digest-slot crow *fn2-fc-previous-seal*) 4294967296)))
          (mv (if (eq code :ok) :bounds code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
         (fn2-fc-context (fn2-run-seal-context w crow hrow fn2-run-writers fn2-fc-context)))
     (mv :more l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:seal-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
          (fn2-run-seal-step w crow hrow budget fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests))
         (pages (+ 1 (fn2-run-builds-pages b fn2-run-builds)))
         (fn2-run-builds (if (and (eq code :ok) (unsigned-byte-p 60 pages))
                             (fn2-run-builds-set-pages b pages fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv (case code (:ok :sealed) (:more :more) (otherwise code))
         l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:finish-close
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-close w fn2-run-writers)))
     (mv (if (eq code :ok) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:root
    (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv :root l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (otherwise
    (mv action l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))))

; Finishing: the remaining open levels close bottom up; an empty run has no
; root and is :empty.
(defun fn2-run-build-finish (b fn2-run-builds)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-builds
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds)))))
 (cond ((not (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*)) (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
       ((zp (fn2-run-builds-entries b fn2-run-builds))
        (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :empty fn2-run-builds)))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :ok fn2-run-builds)))))

; Promotion, the generic parts. Check: the sealed level L can promote now
; (:go), or the level above needs a page first, growing the height when L is
; the top. Child reference: the parent-held hash goes to the hash slot at
; 32 L and the reference fields are set by the ref layout's field names
; relative to CB, the index layout's CHILD- base. Commit: :full closes the
; parent (the promotion stays pending); :ok idles L for its next page.
(defun fn2-run-promote-check (b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (natp l))))
 (b* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< (+ 1 l) *fn2-run-max-levels*) (< l (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :levels fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
      ((when (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds)))
       (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-height b (+ 2 l) fn2-run-builds))) (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
      ((when (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l 1) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
  (mv :go fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-promote-check-shape (fn2-run-promote-check b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (and (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
 ((fn2-run-builds 1)))
(in-theory (disable fn2-run-promote-check))

(defun fn2-run-child-ref (w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
              (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp w) (natp l) (natp cb) (natp eb) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (<= (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-num-fields*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< eb (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (fn2-digest-rowp hrow fn2-digests)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-digest-store 32 hrow hslot hgen (* 32 l) okind oslot ogen fn2-digests fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (unit (fn2-run-writers-unit w fn2-run-writers)) (epoch (fn2-run-writers-epoch w fn2-run-writers))
      (counter (fn2-run-writers-counter w fn2-run-writers)) (kind (fn2-run-writers-page-kind w fn2-run-writers))
      (entries (fn2-run-writers-entries w fn2-run-writers)))
  (if (not (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 unit) (unsigned-byte-p 60 epoch) (unsigned-byte-p 60 counter)
                (unsigned-byte-p 60 kind) (unsigned-byte-p 60 entries)))
      (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool)
   (let* ((h (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-expected-hash*))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-storage-domain*) 0 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-physical-unit*) unit fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-writer-epoch*) epoch fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-allocation*) counter fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-page-kind*) kind fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-encoded-length*) *fn2-run-page-size* fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value h 1 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-slot h hslot fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-gen h hgen fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-off h (* 32 l) fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-len h 32 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value eb entries fn2-fields)))
    (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool)))))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-child-ref-shape
 (fn2-run-child-ref w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (and (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-digestsp fn2-digests)

donor.range:
; Layer C3: range reads over a schema's overlays and live runs, and the read
; contract (UNIVERSAL-CONSTRUCTIONS 2.4 with section 12 decision 2).
;
; A range read delivers, in key order, the entries whose keys lie in
; [lo, hi]: a merge of one source per overlay of the schema (active or
; frozen) and per live run. Each source holds one decoded head; a step
; advances the sources that need it, delivers the least head, and makes
; that key's successor the query, so the read's meaning is its resume key
; and the schema's version, never a physical position. When the version
; moved (a seal, a merge) every source is found again strictly after the
; resume key; when an overlay took an insert its source is located again.
; Equal keys in two sources (an overlay and the run it is being sealed into)
; deliver once, the newest source winning: an overlay is newer than any
; run, a run with a greater identifier newer than one with a smaller, an
; overlay taken later (its SEQ: batch order, C-S3) newer than one taken
; earlier.
; Range reads take schemas whose key fields are integers (C-RANGE-KEYS).
; Every step is bounded; :more resumes, :miss names the page a run source's
; cursor waits for.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-assemble")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

(defcolumns fn2-ranges
 ((phase (:enum fn2-range-phase (:idle :seek :merge :done)))
  (schema :u60) (qbase :u32) (hbase :u32) (sbase :u32) (smax :u32) (scount :u32)
  (cbase :u32) (rbase :u32) (vrun :u60) (pfield :u32) (plimit :u60)
  (out :u32) (ok :u8) (os :u32) (og :u60) (delivered :u60)
  (qk :u8) (qs :u32) (qg :u60)))
; A source's SRC is its overlay row or its run's fn2-run-installed row (not
; named REF: the reference view names each core child's copy NAME-REF).
(defcolumns fn2-range-sources
 ((kind (:enum fn2-range-kind (:none :overlay :run)))
  (src :u32) (state (:enum fn2-range-state (:seek :next :scan :head :end)))
  (pos :u32) (count :u32) (cursor :u32) (rb :u32) (run :u60)
  (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))
; A read with no position limit names this field.
(defconst *fn2-range-no-position* 4294967295)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The read contract. STRENGTH is :exactly-at or :at-least, P the position
; asked for, FALLBACK :wait, :stale-ok or :catch-up, COV the schema's
; coverage, APPEND whether the schema is a stream (an entry never changes,
; so its prefix at any position up to cov is retained) or latest-only.
; (mv outcome position limit): :read at POSITION, LIMIT the greatest
; position a delivered stream entry may carry (nil: none); :stale (read at
; cov, said so); :wait (at cov; come back when cov reaches p); :gap (exact
; history at p is not retained); :unavailable (catch-up needs maintenance
; state and a suffix interpreter this schema does not have); :refused.
; Every outcome carries its position.
(defun fn2-read-plan (strength p fallback cov append)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((not (and (natp p) (natp cov) (member-eq strength '(:exactly-at :at-least))
                  (member-eq fallback '(:wait :stale-ok :catch-up))))
        (mv :refused 0 nil))
       ((<= p cov)
        (cond ((eq strength :at-least) (mv :read cov nil))
              (append (mv :read p p))
              ((equal p cov) (mv :read cov nil))
              (t (mv :gap cov nil))))
       ((eq fallback :wait) (mv :wait cov nil))
       ((eq fallback :stale-ok) (mv :stale cov nil))
       (t (mv :unavailable cov nil))))
(assert-event (and (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 5 :wait 9 t)) '(:read 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 t)) '(:read 5 5))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 nil)) '(:gap 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 9 :wait 9 nil)) '(:read 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :wait 9 t)) '(:wait 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :stale-ok 9 t)) '(:stale 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 12 :catch-up 9 t)) '(:unavailable 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :sometime 1 :wait 9 t)) '(:refused 0 nil))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Sources. Source I of range G is row SBASE+I; a run source reads through
; cursor row CBASE+I; every source's head is decoded at the reader region
; RBASE + I * reader-fields (its entry rows at +*fn2-run-reader-entry*).
(defmacro fn2-rg-ok (g) `(and (natp ,g) (< ,g (fn2-ranges-rows fn2-ranges))))

      ((unless (< i (fn2-ranges-smax g fn2-ranges))) (mv :sources fn2-range-sources))
      (row (+ (fn2-ranges-sbase g fn2-ranges) i))
      (cursor (+ (fn2-ranges-cbase g fn2-ranges) i))

      ((unless (and (< row (fn2-range-sources-rows fn2-range-sources)) (natp kind) (< kind *fn2-range-kind-count*)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 ref) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cursor) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rb) (unsigned-byte-p 60 run)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 ok) (unsigned-byte-p 32 os) (unsigned-byte-p 60 og)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-range-sources))
      (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-put row (kind kind) (src ref) (state *fn2-range-state-seek*) (pos 0) (count 0)
                                                (cursor cursor) (rb rb) (run run) (okind ok) (oslot os) (ogen og))))
  (mv :ok fn2-range-sources)))
(fn2-range-sources-preserves fn2-range-add-source (g i kind ref run ok os og fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources) :position 1 :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-rangesp fn2-ranges) (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sourcesp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources)))
; The schema's overlays (active or frozen), from overlay row N-1 down; I is
; the next source index. (mv code i sources)

  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-range-add-source)))))

; (Re)find every source: the schema's overlays and live runs, all to seek
; strictly after the current query, the version taken now.
(defun fn2-range-enumerate (g fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-run-installed)
  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)
              (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-range-add-overlays fn2-range-add-runs)))))
 (b* (((unless (fn2-rg-ok g)) (mv :bounds fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))
      (sid (fn2-ranges-schema g fn2-ranges))
      ((mv code i fn2-range-sources)
       (fn2-range-add-overlays (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 g sid fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))

       (fn2-range-add-runs (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) i g sid 0 fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))

      ((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 i) (unsigned-byte-p 60 vrun))) (mv :bounds fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))

  (mv :ok fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources)))

 :hyps ((fn2-rangesp fn2-ranges) (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sourcesp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources)))

; An overlay that took an insert since its source located it is located
; again (strictly after the query); N counts the sources down.
(defun fn2-range-recheck (n g fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays)

  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp n))))

      ((unless (fn2-rg-ok g)) (mv :bounds fn2-range-sources))
      (s (+ (fn2-ranges-sbase g fn2-ranges) (- n 1)))
      ((unless (< s (fn2-range-sources-rows fn2-range-sources))) (mv :bounds fn2-range-sources))
      (o (fn2-range-sources-src s fn2-range-sources))
      (fn2-range-sources
       (if (and (equal (fn2-range-sources-kind s fn2-range-sources) *fn2-range-kind-overlay*)
                (not (equal (fn2-range-sources-state s fn2-range-sources) *fn2-range-state-seek*))
                (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
                (not (equal (fn2-overlays-count o fn2-overlays) (fn2-range-sources-count s fn2-range-sources))))

 :hyps ((fn2-rangesp fn2-ranges) (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sourcesp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources)))

; Start range read G over schema SID. The caller holds lo's key fields at
; QBASE and hi's at HBASE (query owner QK QS QG); PFIELD names the entry's
; position field and PLIMIT the greatest position delivered (a stream read
; exactly at PLIMIT), or PFIELD is *fn2-range-no-position*.
(defun fn2-range-start (g sid qbase hbase sbase smax cbase rbase pfield plimit qk qs qg
                          fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-run-installed)

  :guard (and (fn2-ranges-wfp fn2-ranges) (fn2-range-sources-wfp fn2-range-sources) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)
              (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-range-enumerate)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-rg-ok g) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid) (unsigned-byte-p 32 qbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hbase)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 sbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 smax) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rbase)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 pfield) (unsigned-byte-p 60 plimit)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 qk) (unsigned-byte-p 32 qs) (unsigned-byte-p 60 qg)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))
      (fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-put g (phase *fn2-range-phase-idle*) (schema sid) (qbase qbase) (hbase hbase) (sbase sbase)
                                  (smax smax) (scount 0) (cbase cbase) (rbase rbase) (vrun 0) (pfield pfield) (plimit plimit)
                                  (out 0) (ok 0) (os 0) (og 0) (delivered 0) (qk qk) (qs qs) (qg qg))))

; A positioned seek (INBOX 4.1, Seek(stream, after = p)) over a stream whose
; position grows with its key's last field (overview within a group): the
; least last-field value N from which every entry carries a position above
; P, found by bisection over range reads of one entry each (C-POSITION-SEEK). A row
; drives range G: its query and hi regions hold the stream's key prefix;
; the seek writes only their last key field.
(defcolumns fn2-seeks
 ((phase (:enum fn2-seek-phase (:idle :probe :read :entry :end :done)))
  (g :u32) (lo :u60) (hi :u60) (mid :u60) (after :u60) (pfield :u32) (probes :u32)))
; Start positioned seek K over range row G (already started by the caller
; on the stream's prefix: its query and hi regions hold the prefix fields):
; the answer is the least last-field value in [LO, HI] from which every
; entry has a position above P. PFIELD names the position field.
(defun fn2-seek-start (k g lo hi p pfield fn2-seeks)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seeks :guard (fn2-seeks-wfp fn2-seeks)))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp k) (< k (fn2-seeks-rows fn2-seeks)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 g) (unsigned-byte-p 60 lo)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 hi) (unsigned-byte-p 60 p) (unsigned-byte-p 32 pfield)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-seeks))
      (fn2-seeks (fn2-seeks-put k (phase *fn2-seek-phase-probe*) (g g) (lo lo) (hi hi) (mid lo) (after p)
                                            (pfield pfield) (probes 0))))
  (mv :ok fn2-seeks)))
; Copy N field rows from FROM to TO (value, reference, status).
(defun fn2-range-copy-rows (n from to fn2-fields)

  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp n) (natp from) (natp to))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-copy-row)))))

       ((not (and (natp from) (natp to) (< (+ from n -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< (+ to n -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
        (mv :bounds fn2-fields))
       (t (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-run-copy-row (+ from n -1) (+ to n -1) fn2-fields)))

(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-range-copy-rows (n from to fn2-fields) :position 1

; The parts that read entries, generated after the run assembly.
(defun fn2-rga-integer-kindp (k)

     (and (consp k) (member-eq (car k) '(:id :enum)))))

(defun fn2-rga-integer-ids (rows)

       ((fn2-rga-integer-keysp (fn2-decl-get :key (cdar rows))) (cons (fn2-decl-get :id (cdar rows)) (fn2-rga-integer-ids (cdr rows))))
       (t (fn2-rga-integer-ids (cdr rows)))))

         (out (fn2-ranges-out g fn2-ranges)) (nk (fn2-run-layout-keys (fn2-ranges-schema g fn2-ranges)))
         (pf (fn2-seeks-pfield k fn2-seeks))
         ((unless (and (posp nk) (< pf *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (< (+ out pf) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                       (< (+ out nk -1) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
          (mv :bounds fn2-seeks))
         (n (nfix (fn2-fields-value (+ out nk -1) fn2-fields)))
         (pos (nfix (fn2-fields-value (+ out pf) fn2-fields)))
         ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 (+ 1 n))) (mv :bounds fn2-seeks))
         (fn2-seeks (if (< (fn2-seeks-after k fn2-seeks) pos)
                              (fn2-seeks-put k (phase *fn2-seek-phase-probe*) (hi n))
                            (fn2-seeks-put k (phase *fn2-seek-phase-probe*) (lo (+ 1 n))))))
     (mv :more fn2-seeks)))
   ;; One bounded step: :more, :miss, :done (the answer is the row's LO), or a refusal.
   (defun fn2-seek-step (k budget fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                           fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                             fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
     :guard (and (fn2-seeks-wfp fn2-seeks) (fn2-rga-guard) (natp budget))
     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-seek-probe fn2-seek-narrow fn2-range-step)))))
    (b* (((unless (and (natp k) (< k (fn2-seeks-rows fn2-seeks))))
          (mv :bounds fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
         (phase (fn2-seeks-phase k fn2-seeks)))
     (cond
      ((equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-done*) (mv :done fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      ((equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-probe*)
       (mv-let (code fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-fields)
         (fn2-seek-probe k fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-run-installed fn2-fields)
        (mv code fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
      ((equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-read*)
       (b* (((mv code fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
             (fn2-range-step (fn2-seeks-g k fn2-seeks) budget fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index
                             fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool))
            (fn2-seeks (case code
                         (:entry (fn2-seeks-set-phase k *fn2-seek-phase-entry* fn2-seeks))
                         (:end (fn2-seeks-set-phase k *fn2-seek-phase-end* fn2-seeks))
                         (otherwise fn2-seeks))))
        (mv (if (member-eq code '(:entry :end)) :more code) fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
      ((or (equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-entry*) (equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-end*))
       (mv-let (code fn2-seeks)
         (fn2-seek-narrow k (if (equal phase *fn2-seek-phase-entry*) :entry :end) fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-fields)
        (mv code fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
      (t (mv :state fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))))
   (in-theory (disable fn2-seek-step))
   (assert-event (fn2-assert-compliant-p '(fn2-seek-step) (w state)))
   (fn2-range-adapters)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Specification (lists; logic only). SOURCES are entry lists, oldest first:
; the runs in the order of their identifiers, then the overlay; an entry of
; a later source replaces one with an equal key. A read delivers the union
; in key order, from LO to HI (key value lists), up to the first entry whose
; field PIDX exceeds PLIMIT when PIDX is a field index.
(defun fn2-range-put-spec (key e acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom acc) (list e))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car acc) e) :lt) (cons (car acc) (fn2-range-put-spec key e (cdr acc))))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car acc) e) :eq) (cons e (cdr acc)))
       (t (cons e acc))))
(defun fn2-range-puts-spec (key es acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom es) acc (fn2-range-puts-spec key (cdr es) (fn2-range-put-spec key (car es) acc))))
(defun fn2-range-union-spec (key sources acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sources) acc (fn2-range-union-spec key (cdr sources) (fn2-range-puts-spec key (car sources) acc))))
(defun fn2-range-window-spec (key es lo hi pidx plimit)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) nil)
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car es) lo) :lt) (fn2-range-window-spec key (cdr es) lo hi pidx plimit))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car es) hi) :gt) nil)
       ((and (natp pidx) (< (nfix plimit) (nfix (nth pidx (car es))))) nil)
       (t (cons (car es) (fn2-range-window-spec key (cdr es) lo hi pidx plimit)))))
(defun fn2-range-spec (key sources lo hi pidx plimit)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-window-spec key (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) lo hi pidx plimit))
; Inputs the adapter accepts: at most six sources of at most 48 sorted,
; well-formed entries each; a budget of at least one.
(defun fn2-range-listsp (layout key sources)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sources) (null sources)
  (and (true-listp (car sources)) (<= (len (car sources)) 48)
       (fn2-run-entries-layoutp layout (car sources)) (fn2-run-sorted-spec key (car sources))
       (fn2-range-listsp layout key (cdr sources)))))
(defun fn2-range-inputp (layout key sources budget)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (and (fn2-layoutp layout) (consp sources) (<= (len sources) 6) (fn2-range-listsp layout key sources) (posp budget)))


; Positioned seek specification: over the union, among the entries whose
; first key fields equal PREFIX and whose last key field is below HI, the
; answer is one more than the last key field of the last entry whose field
; PIDX is at most P, or 0 when none is: reading from there delivers exactly
; the entries after position P. Positions grow with the key within a prefix.
(defun fn2-range-prefixp (prefix e)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom prefix) (and (consp e) (equal (car prefix) (car e)) (fn2-range-prefixp (cdr prefix) (cdr e)))))
(defun fn2-range-seek-scan (es prefix nk p hi pidx acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) acc)
       ((and (fn2-range-prefixp prefix (car es)) (< (nfix (nth (- nk 1) (car es))) hi) (<= (nfix (nth pidx (car es))) p))
        (fn2-range-seek-scan (cdr es) prefix nk p hi pidx (+ 1 (nfix (nth (- nk 1) (car es))))))
       (t (fn2-range-seek-scan (cdr es) prefix nk p hi pidx acc))))
(defun fn2-range-seek-spec (key sources prefix p hi pidx)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-seek-scan (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) prefix (len key) p hi pidx 0))
(defun fn2-range-monotone-scan (es prefix pidx last)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) t)
       ((fn2-range-prefixp prefix (car es))
        (and (< last (nfix (nth pidx (car es)))) (fn2-range-monotone-scan (cdr es) prefix pidx (nfix (nth pidx (car es))))))
       (t (fn2-range-monotone-scan (cdr es) prefix pidx last))))
; Positions strictly grow with the key within PREFIX in the union.
(defun fn2-range-monotonep (key sources prefix pidx)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-monotone-scan (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) prefix pidx -1))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Logic adapter. RUNS (oldest first) are built through the real build and
; installed as runs 1, 2, ...; OVERLAY is inserted through the real insert;
; the read runs with BUDGET per step. SEALAT, when a number, seals the
; overlay into a further run right after that many deliveries (the sources
; move under the read). Field plan above the run adapter's: lo at 1400, hi
; at 1500, sources' heads from 2000; owner (9 0 1), queries (10 0 1).
(defconst *fn2-rga-stobjs*
 '(fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
   fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
(defmacro fn2-rga-defun (name args &rest r)
 (let* ((measure (and (eq (car r) :measure) (cadr r))) (body (if measure (caddr r) (car r))))
  `(defun ,name ,(append args *fn2-rga-stobjs*)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs ,*fn2-rga-stobjs* :verify-guards nil ,@(and measure `(:measure ,measure))))
    ,body)))
(defmacro fn2-rga-mv (&rest values) `(mv ,@values ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-rga-call (name &rest args) `(,name ,@args ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-rga-local (name &rest args) `(fn2-run-with-local ,*fn2-rga-stobjs* (,name ,@args ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*)))
(defconst *fn2-rga-lo* 1400)
(defconst *fn2-rga-hi* 1500)
(defconst *fn2-rga-heads* 2000)
(defconst *fn2-rga-smax* 8)

(defmacro fn2-range-adapters ()
 '(progn
   (fn2-rga-defun fn2-rga-setup ()
    (b* ((fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-init 1 fn2-ranges))
         (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-init *fn2-rga-smax* fn2-range-sources))
         (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init 1 fn2-overlays))

         (fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init 4096 fn2-run-cache))

         (fn2-fc-context (fn2-fc-context-init 1 fn2-fc-context))

   (fn2-rga-defun fn2-rga-overlay (sid layout entries)
    (b* (((mv & aslot agen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 9 0 1 fn2-pool))

         ((mv code fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
              fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)

       (:more (fn2-rga-call fn2-rga-drive (- fuel 1) sid layout budget sealat k))
       (:end (fn2-rga-mv nil))
       (:entry
        (b* ((e (fn2-run-unload-values layout (fn2-ranges-out 0 fn2-ranges) fn2-fields fn2-pool))
             ((mv sealed fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths

                  fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
              (fn2-rga-call fn2-rga-drive (- fuel 1) sid layout budget sealat k)))

   (fn2-rga-defun fn2-rga-run (sid layout sources lo hi pidx plimit budget sealat)
    (b* (((mv & fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths

              fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)

         ((mv code fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
              fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)

   (defun fn2-range-image (sid layout sources lo hi pidx plimit budget sealat)
    (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
    (fn2-rga-local fn2-rga-run sid layout sources lo hi pidx plimit budget sealat))

   ;; an overlay and runs, the overlay sealed into a run in the middle of the
   ;; read, delivers exactly the specified window of the union.

             (equal (fn2-range-image 3 *fn2-overview-entry* sources lo hi pidx plimit budget sealat)
                    (fn2-range-spec '((group (:id group)) (number (:id group-number))) sources lo hi pidx plimit)))
    :teeth (fn2-range-read-exact-positive fn2-range-read-exact-negative)
    :schema :g1 :claim :representation
    :doc "A range read over a schema's overlay and runs (its key's successor as the resume point, its sources found again when they move) delivers, in key order, the newest entry of each key between lo and hi, up to the position limit, whatever the step budget and whenever the overlay is sealed.")
   ;; Positioned seek adapter: the range image's sources; range 0 holds the

   (defun fn2-rgs-drive (fuel budget fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests) :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix fuel)))
    (if (zp fuel) (mv :fuel fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
     (mv-let (code fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)
       (fn2-seek-step 0 budget fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                      fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
      (if (eq code :more)
          (fn2-rgs-drive (- fuel 1) budget fn2-seeks fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)

donor.machines-c:
; Layer C in the served core (C-ONE-ASSEMBLY; seam C-S1, docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §4a and §8): the engine's resident tables registered as core children, and
; each transaction's field-row stripe. The identity decision over them is
; machines-c-groups.lisp's (two exact reads); a transaction's writes go
; through the private successor (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp). The run
; and range assemblies are range-served.lisp's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "range-served")
(include-book "machines-b")
(include-book "successor-schema-geometry")
(include-book "c-snapshot")
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-state")
(include-book "run-physical-geometry")
(include-book "run-physical-harvest")
(include-book "startup-genesis-state")
(include-book "c-source-observer")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field rows. B's format work uses a 128-row stripe per format slot from row 0
; (commit.lisp: base = 128 * row); transaction T's stripe is the
; *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*-row supported stripe ending (transactions - T) stripes before
; the table's end. machines-b sizes the table for both (fn2-b-field-rows). In
; a stripe (C-STRIPE): the successor's 24 write slots from +0, one 48-row
; block each (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp), then the exact lookup's area
; from +1152: its query at +4 (the identity decision's key: namespace, name,
; profile, algorithm, digest), the run reader at +84 (its rows also take the
; entry a bind writes).
(defconst *fn2-idc-stride* *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-idc-b-stripe* 128)
(defconst *fn2-succ-slots* 24)

(defconst *fn2-idc-ident* (* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-succ-block*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-eb* (+ *fn2-idc-ident* 4))
(defconst *fn2-idc-rb* (+ *fn2-idc-eb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-required-fields*
 (fn2-successor-required-fields *fn2-succ-fields-max* *fn2-succ-values-max*
  *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-run-entry-rows* *fn2-run-reader-fields*))
(assert-event (<= *fn2-idc-required-fields* *fn2-idc-stride*))
(assert-event (and (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-reader-fields*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ (* (- *fn2-succ-slots* 1) *fn2-succ-block*) *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:format-slots . 2))) (+ (* 2 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*))))

;; The overlay rows a profile gets when it names none (:identity-overlays):
;; a batch takes one private overlay per schema it writes, and a POST
;; writes up to 10 today (the five identity records, article, outcome,
;; counts, overview, addr) of the 16 a transaction could name; B keeps two
;; batches in flight (its two commit rows) and the sealer works on the
;; frozen ones behind them. So 16 schemas x 3 batches. Each overlay in use
;; holds one arena of :identity-arena-bytes from the pool; the pool must
;; carry them (c-ordered-runs.md §5, capacity).
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlays-default* 48)
;; The sealer's merge (C5, sealer.lisp) reads at most eight sources, one run
;; cursor each, after every read row's (t + 9R ..).
(defconst *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 8)
;; A reader merges at most *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* (8) sources of a schema:
;; its overlays (active, frozen or private) and its live runs. The sealer
;; keeps a schema to *fn2-idc-run-budget* runs (it merges every run once a
;; schema holds that many, sealer.lisp) and stage keeps it to
;; *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* overlays (a transaction that would take one more
;; waits, :full, until the sealer catches up: machines-c-stage.lisp).
(defconst *fn2-idc-run-budget* 4)
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* (- *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* *fn2-idc-run-budget*))
;; Source observers name actual resumable operation rows, not actor identities.
;; Reads and successor resolutions have distinct endpoints even when one actor
;; owns both.  Their following endpoint protects the complete sealer merge;
;; cursor-response and CNS-metadata parents occupy the disjoint tail.
(defun fn2-c-source-endpoint-rows (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 2 (fn2-b-read-rows profile))
    (fn2-b-cursor-rows profile) (fn2-b-cns-rows profile)))
(defun fn2-c-source-successor-endpoint (read-rows tx)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp read-rows) (natp tx))))
 (+ read-rows tx))
(defun fn2-c-source-sealer-endpoint (read-rows successor-rows)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp read-rows) (natp successor-rows))))
 (+ read-rows successor-rows))
(defun fn2-c-source-request-endpoint (read-rows successor-rows cursor-row)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp read-rows) (natp successor-rows) (natp cursor-row))))
 (+ 1 read-rows successor-rows cursor-row))
(defun fn2-c-source-cns-endpoint (read-rows successor-rows cursor-rows cns-row)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp read-rows) (natp successor-rows) (natp cursor-rows) (natp cns-row))))
 (+ 1 read-rows successor-rows cursor-rows cns-row))
(defthm fn2-c-source-endpoint-rows-natp
 (natp (fn2-c-source-endpoint-rows profile)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defun fn2-idc-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-c-source-endpoint-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-t profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                             (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-arena-bytes 65536 profile))
      ;; Layer D's read rows (C-S4, machines-c-read.lisp): R of them, each
      ;; with 8 range sources, a lookup row and cursor after the
      ;; transactions' (t + R) and 8 source cursors after those (t + 9R).
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)))
      (<= (+ (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix (fn2-b-format-slots profile)))
             (* *fn2-idc-stride* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*
             (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (fn2-b-read-rows profile)))
          (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile)))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile) (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)))))

;; Each child's init is a function whose guard is proved here once, so the
;; core init's guard (assembly-init) meets only the opaque profile predicate.
(defmacro fn2-idc-child (field stobj init why)
 (let ((fn (fn2-columns-sym stobj "-INIT-FOR")))
  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-idc-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-idc-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-idc-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))
    (defcorechild ,field ,stobj :init (,fn profile ,stobj) :profilep (fn2-idc-profilep profile) :why ,why))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-idc-profilep))

(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlays fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile) fn2-overlays)

                            (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))) fn2-overlay-index)
 "Each overlay's key-ordered index of its arena's entries.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-installed fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init (+ (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile) (fn2-b-capacity :extent-slots 16 profile)) fn2-run-installed)

 (fn2-run-load-profile-init profile fn2-run-loads)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Decision D's stripe base, or :bounds when D is no decision row or the
; stripes would reach into B's (FCROWS format slots).
(defun fn2-idc-stripe (d fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
  (if (and (natp d) (< d n) (natp rows) (natp n)
           (<= (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n))))
      (mv :ok (+ (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n)) (* *fn2-idc-stride* d)))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

before.runs:
; Layer C: multi-page runs. Level 0 holds the entries; each sealed page's
; first key and parent-held reference become one entry of the level above.
; A build owns one writer row per level; its caller supplies pages and
; records each sealed page. Every call is bounded; :more resumes.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-geometry")
(include-book "runs-schema")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

; A format parameter, not a ceiling on stored entries: with 64 KiB pages and
; index entries of at most 350 bytes, six levels address over 10^13 pages.

; Field rows a build owns: one writer range per level, then one index-entry
; region where a sealed page's first key and reference are assembled.
(defconst *fn2-run-build-index* (* *fn2-run-max-levels* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-run-build-fields* (+ *fn2-run-build-index* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))

(defcolumns fn2-run-builds

;; Inputs one adapter run accepts: at most 64 sorted well-formed entries, and
;; a fill limit at which every page holds at least two entries or index
;; entries, so six levels and the adapter's 160 pages suffice.
(defun fn2-run-run-inputp (layout key entries limit)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (and (fn2-layoutp layout) (consp entries) (<= (len entries) 64)
      (fn2-run-entries-layoutp layout entries) (fn2-run-sorted-spec key entries)
      (natp limit) (<= limit *fn2-run-page-size*)
      (<= (+ *fn2-run-entries-base*
             (* 2 (+ *fn2-run-restart-bytes*
                     (max (fn2-layout-max-size layout) (fn2-layout-max-size (fn2-rs-index-layout key))))))
          limit)))
;; A scan from the lower bound of Q: the next N entries in key order, then
;; :count, or the entries left, then :end.
(defun fn2-run-from-spec (key entries q)

 (cond ((atom entries) nil)
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car entries) q) :lt) (fn2-run-from-spec key (cdr entries) q))
       (t entries)))
(defun fn2-run-take-spec (rest n)

       (t (cons (car rest) (fn2-run-take-spec (cdr rest) (- n 1))))))
(defun fn2-run-scan-spec (key entries q n)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-run-take-spec (fn2-run-from-spec key entries q) n))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Installed runs: the engine's resident view of each schema's sealed runs (the
; manifest, C1c, makes it durable). A row names a run's root page (its level,
; cache slot and physical identity, the owner its pages are read under) and
; its entry count; UFIRST..ULAST the physical units its pages (and its
; filter page) were sealed under (the seal row hands units out in order, one
; build at a time, so a run's pages are exactly the cached units in that
; interval: another run's page under a unit of it has another unit, since
; the cache is keyed by the exact unit); FILTER says whether the run has a Ribbon filter page
; (ribbon.lisp), named by its physical identity (FUNIT, FCOUNTER) and read
; through the verified-page cache under the run's owner.

                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 unit) (unsigned-byte-p 60 counter) (unsigned-byte-p 60 entries)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-installed))

                           (top top) (slot slot) (gen gen) (unit unit) (counter counter) (entries entries)
                           (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen) (filter 0) (funit 0) (fcounter 0))))

; A schema's version: the greatest run identifier among its live runs.
; Run identifiers only grow, and every installation (a seal, C5's merge)
; installs a new one, so the version moves whenever facts move from an
; overlay into a run. A reader that holds it (an identity decision, a range
; read) knows by comparing it whether its sources moved under it.
(defun fn2-run-version (sid n fn2-run-installed)

  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp n) (<= n (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))))
 (if (zp n) 0
  (let ((r (- n 1)) (rest (fn2-run-version sid (- n 1) fn2-run-installed)))
   (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
            (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid)
            (< rest (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))))
       (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)) rest))))

before.range:
; Layer C3: range reads over a schema's overlays and live runs, and the read
; contract (UNIVERSAL-CONSTRUCTIONS 2.4 with section 12 decision 2).
;
; A range read delivers, in key order, the entries whose keys lie in
; [lo, hi]: a merge of one source per overlay of the schema (active or
; frozen) and per live run. Each source holds one decoded head; a step
; advances the sources that need it, delivers the least head, and makes
; that key's successor the query, so the read's meaning is its resume key
; and the schema's version, never a physical position. When the version
; moved (a seal, a merge) every source is found again strictly after the
; resume key; when an overlay took an insert its source is located again.
; Equal keys in two sources (an overlay and the run it is being sealed into)
; deliver once, the newest source winning: an overlay is newer than any
; run, a run with a greater identifier newer than one with a smaller, an
; overlay taken later (its SEQ: batch order, C-S3) newer than one taken
; earlier.
; Range reads take schemas whose key fields are integers (C-RANGE-KEYS).
; Every step is bounded; :more resumes, :miss names the page a run source's
; cursor waits for.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-assemble")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

(defcolumns fn2-ranges
 ((phase (:enum fn2-range-phase (:idle :seek :merge :done)))
  (schema :u60) (qbase :u32) (hbase :u32) (sbase :u32) (smax :u32) (scount :u32)
  (cbase :u32) (rbase :u32) (vrun :u60) (pfield :u32) (plimit :u60)
  (out :u32) (ok :u8) (os :u32) (og :u60) (delivered :u60)
  (qk :u8) (qs :u32) (qg :u60)))
; A source's SRC is its overlay row or its run's fn2-run-installed row (not
; named REF: the reference view names each core child's copy NAME-REF).
(defcolumns fn2-range-sources
 ((kind (:enum fn2-range-kind (:none :overlay :run)))
  (src :u32) (state (:enum fn2-range-state (:seek :next :scan :head :end)))
  (pos :u32) (count :u32) (cursor :u32) (rb :u32) (run :u60)
  (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))

(defconst *fn2-range-no-position* 4294967295)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The read contract. STRENGTH is :exactly-at or :at-least, P the position
; asked for, FALLBACK :wait, :stale-ok or :catch-up, COV the schema's
; coverage, APPEND whether the schema is a stream (an entry never changes,
; so its prefix at any position up to cov is retained) or latest-only.
; (mv outcome position limit): :read at POSITION, LIMIT the greatest
; position a delivered stream entry may carry (nil: none); :stale (read at
; cov, said so); :wait (at cov; come back when cov reaches p); :gap (exact
; history at p is not retained); :unavailable (catch-up needs maintenance
; state and a suffix interpreter this schema does not have); :refused.
; Every outcome carries its position.
(defun fn2-read-plan (strength p fallback cov append)

                  (member-eq fallback '(:wait :stale-ok :catch-up))))
        (mv :refused 0 nil))
       ((<= p cov)
        (cond ((eq strength :at-least) (mv :read cov nil))
              (append (mv :read p p))
              ((equal p cov) (mv :read cov nil))
              (t (mv :gap cov nil))))
       ((eq fallback :wait) (mv :wait cov nil))
       ((eq fallback :stale-ok) (mv :stale cov nil))
       (t (mv :unavailable cov nil))))

                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 t)) '(:read 5 5))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 5 :wait 9 nil)) '(:gap 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 9 :wait 9 nil)) '(:read 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :wait 9 t)) '(:wait 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :at-least 12 :stale-ok 9 t)) '(:stale 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :exactly-at 12 :catch-up 9 t)) '(:unavailable 9 nil))
                   (equal (mv-list 3 (fn2-read-plan :sometime 1 :wait 9 t)) '(:refused 0 nil))))

   ;; The positioned seek's step, over range row G's regions.

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Specification (lists; logic only). SOURCES are entry lists, oldest first:
; the runs in the order of their identifiers, then the overlay; an entry of
; a later source replaces one with an equal key. A read delivers the union
; in key order, from LO to HI (key value lists), up to the first entry whose
; field PIDX exceeds PLIMIT when PIDX is a field index.
(defun fn2-range-put-spec (key e acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom acc) (list e))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car acc) e) :lt) (cons (car acc) (fn2-range-put-spec key e (cdr acc))))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car acc) e) :eq) (cons e (cdr acc)))
       (t (cons e acc))))
(defun fn2-range-puts-spec (key es acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom es) acc (fn2-range-puts-spec key (cdr es) (fn2-range-put-spec key (car es) acc))))
(defun fn2-range-union-spec (key sources acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sources) acc (fn2-range-union-spec key (cdr sources) (fn2-range-puts-spec key (car sources) acc))))
(defun fn2-range-window-spec (key es lo hi pidx plimit)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) nil)
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car es) lo) :lt) (fn2-range-window-spec key (cdr es) lo hi pidx plimit))
       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car es) hi) :gt) nil)
       ((and (natp pidx) (< (nfix plimit) (nfix (nth pidx (car es))))) nil)
       (t (cons (car es) (fn2-range-window-spec key (cdr es) lo hi pidx plimit)))))
(defun fn2-range-spec (key sources lo hi pidx plimit)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-window-spec key (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) lo hi pidx plimit))
; Inputs the adapter accepts: at most six sources of at most 48 sorted,
; well-formed entries each; a budget of at least one.
(defun fn2-range-listsp (layout key sources)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom sources) (null sources)
  (and (true-listp (car sources)) (<= (len (car sources)) 48)
       (fn2-run-entries-layoutp layout (car sources)) (fn2-run-sorted-spec key (car sources))
       (fn2-range-listsp layout key (cdr sources)))))
(defun fn2-range-inputp (layout key sources budget)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (and (fn2-layoutp layout) (consp sources) (<= (len sources) 6) (fn2-range-listsp layout key sources) (posp budget)))


; Positioned seek specification: over the union, among the entries whose
; first key fields equal PREFIX and whose last key field is below HI, the
; answer is one more than the last key field of the last entry whose field
; PIDX is at most P, or 0 when none is: reading from there delivers exactly
; the entries after position P. Positions grow with the key within a prefix.
(defun fn2-range-prefixp (prefix e)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom prefix) (and (consp e) (equal (car prefix) (car e)) (fn2-range-prefixp (cdr prefix) (cdr e)))))
(defun fn2-range-seek-scan (es prefix nk p hi pidx acc)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) acc)
       ((and (fn2-range-prefixp prefix (car es)) (< (nfix (nth (- nk 1) (car es))) hi) (<= (nfix (nth pidx (car es))) p))
        (fn2-range-seek-scan (cdr es) prefix nk p hi pidx (+ 1 (nfix (nth (- nk 1) (car es))))))
       (t (fn2-range-seek-scan (cdr es) prefix nk p hi pidx acc))))
(defun fn2-range-seek-spec (key sources prefix p hi pidx)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-seek-scan (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) prefix (len key) p hi pidx 0))
(defun fn2-range-monotone-scan (es prefix pidx last)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom es) t)
       ((fn2-range-prefixp prefix (car es))
        (and (< last (nfix (nth pidx (car es)))) (fn2-range-monotone-scan (cdr es) prefix pidx (nfix (nth pidx (car es))))))
       (t (fn2-range-monotone-scan (cdr es) prefix pidx last))))
; Positions strictly grow with the key within PREFIX in the union.
(defun fn2-range-monotonep (key sources prefix pidx)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (fn2-range-monotone-scan (fn2-range-union-spec key sources nil) prefix pidx -1))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Logic adapter. RUNS (oldest first) are built through the real build and
; installed as runs 1, 2, ...; OVERLAY is inserted through the real insert;
; the read runs with BUDGET per step. SEALAT, when a number, seals the
; overlay into a further run right after that many deliveries (the sources
; move under the read). Field plan above the run adapter's: lo at 1400, hi
; at 1500, sources' heads from 2000; owner (9 0 1), queries (10 0 1).
(defconst *fn2-rga-stobjs*
 '(fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
   fn2-run-cache fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
(defmacro fn2-rga-defun (name args &rest r)
 (let* ((measure (and (eq (car r) :measure) (cadr r))) (body (if measure (caddr r) (car r))))
  `(defun ,name ,(append args *fn2-rga-stobjs*)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs ,*fn2-rga-stobjs* :verify-guards nil ,@(and measure `(:measure ,measure))))
    ,body)))
(defmacro fn2-rga-mv (&rest values) `(mv ,@values ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-rga-call (name &rest args) `(,name ,@args ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-rga-local (name &rest args) `(fn2-run-with-local ,*fn2-rga-stobjs* (,name ,@args ,@*fn2-rga-stobjs*)))
(defconst *fn2-rga-lo* 1400)
(defconst *fn2-rga-hi* 1500)
(defconst *fn2-rga-heads* 2000)
(defconst *fn2-rga-smax* 8)

(defmacro fn2-range-adapters ()
 '(progn
   (fn2-rga-defun fn2-rga-setup ()
    (b* ((fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-init 1 fn2-ranges))
         (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-init *fn2-rga-smax* fn2-range-sources))

       (:end (fn2-rga-mv nil))
       (:entry

before.machines-c:
; Layer C in the served core (C-ONE-ASSEMBLY; seam C-S1, docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §4a and §8): the engine's resident tables registered as core children, and
; each transaction's field-row stripe. The identity decision over them is
; machines-c-groups.lisp's (two exact reads); a transaction's writes go
; through the private successor (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp). The run
; and range assemblies are range-served.lisp's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "range-served")
(include-book "machines-b")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field rows. B's format work uses a 128-row stripe per format slot from row 0
; (commit.lisp: base = 128 * row); transaction T's stripe is the
; *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*-row stripe ending (transactions - T) stripes before
; the table's end. machines-b sizes the table for both (fn2-b-field-rows). In
; a stripe (C-STRIPE): the successor's 24 write slots from +0, one 48-row
; block each (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp), then the exact lookup's area
; from +1152: its query at +4 (the identity decision's key: namespace, name,
; profile, algorithm, digest), the run reader at +84 (its rows also take the
; entry a bind writes).
(defconst *fn2-idc-stride* *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-idc-b-stripe* 128)
(defconst *fn2-succ-slots* 24)
(defconst *fn2-succ-block* 48)
(defconst *fn2-idc-ident* (* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-succ-block*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-eb* (+ *fn2-idc-ident* 4))
(defconst *fn2-idc-rb* (+ *fn2-idc-eb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(assert-event (and (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-reader-fields*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ (* (- *fn2-succ-slots* 1) *fn2-succ-block*) *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:format-slots . 2))) (+ (* 2 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows*))))

;; The overlay rows a profile gets when it names none (:identity-overlays):
;; a batch takes one private overlay per schema it writes, and a POST
;; writes up to 10 today (the five identity records, article, outcome,
;; counts, overview, addr) of the 16 a transaction could name; B keeps two
;; batches in flight (its two commit rows) and the sealer works on the
;; frozen ones behind them. So 16 schemas x 3 batches. Each overlay in use
;; holds one arena of :identity-arena-bytes from the pool; the pool must
;; carry them (c-ordered-runs.md §5, capacity).
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlays-default* 48)
;; The sealer's merge (C5, sealer.lisp) reads at most eight sources, one run
;; cursor each, after every read row's (t + 9R ..).
(defconst *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 8)
;; A reader merges at most *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* (8) sources of a schema:
;; its overlays (active, frozen or private) and its live runs. The sealer
;; keeps a schema to *fn2-idc-run-budget* runs (it merges every run once a
;; schema holds that many, sealer.lisp) and stage keeps it to
;; *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* overlays (a transaction that would take one more
;; waits, :full, until the sealer catches up: machines-c-stage.lisp).
(defconst *fn2-idc-run-budget* 4)
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* (- *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* *fn2-idc-run-budget*))
(defun fn2-idc-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-t profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                             (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-arena-bytes 65536 profile))
      ;; Layer D's read rows (C-S4, machines-c-read.lisp): R of them, each
      ;; with 8 range sources, a lookup row and cursor after the
      ;; transactions' (t + R) and 8 source cursors after those (t + 9R).
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors*))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors*)))
      (<= (+ (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix (fn2-b-format-slots profile)))
             (* *fn2-idc-stride* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows*
             (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (fn2-b-read-rows profile)))
          (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile)))))

;; Each child's init is a function whose guard is proved here once, so the
;; core init's guard (assembly-init) meets only the opaque profile predicate.
(defmacro fn2-idc-child (field stobj init why)
 (let ((fn (fn2-columns-sym stobj "-INIT-FOR")))
  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-idc-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-idc-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-idc-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))
    (defcorechild ,field ,stobj :init (,fn profile ,stobj) :profilep (fn2-idc-profilep profile) :why ,why))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-idc-profilep))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-decides fn2-id-decides (fn2-id-decides-init (fn2-profile-t profile) fn2-id-decides)
 "One identity decision per transaction survives the transaction's yields (C-S1).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlays fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile) fn2-overlays)
 "Bounded sorted overlays hold facts not yet sealed into runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-overlay-index
 (fn2-overlay-index-init (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                            (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))) fn2-overlay-index)
 "Each overlay's key-ordered index of its arena's entries.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-installed fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile) fn2-run-installed)
 "The resident view of each schema's sealed runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cursors fn2-run-cursors
 (fn2-run-cursors-init (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors*) fn2-run-cursors)
 "A decision's resumable run cursor (cursor row = decision row), then each read row's lookup cursor and its range sources' (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-paths fn2-run-paths
 (fn2-run-paths-init (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors*)) fn2-run-paths)
 "Each cursor's descent, one row per level.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cache fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile) fn2-run-cache)
 "Verified run pages, keyed by exact (unit, allocation counter).")

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Decision D's stripe base, or :bounds when D is no decision row or the
; stripes would reach into B's (FCROWS format slots).
(defun fn2-idc-stripe (d fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
  (if (and (natp d) (< d n) (natp rows) (natp n)
           (<= (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n))))
      (mv :ok (+ (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n)) (* *fn2-idc-stride* d)))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

; The output positions of OUTS from POS, for the shape theorems
; (machines-c-successor.lisp's fn2-idc-fn-shape).
(defun fn2-idc-shape-outs (outs pos)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom outs) nil (cons (list (car outs) pos) (fn2-idc-shape-outs (cdr outs) (+ 1 pos)))))
